items.quote: If you plan to distribute your app to multiple accounts (either through listing on the HubSpot Marketplace or by managing specific authorized accounts), your app must be built using OAuth authentication.
items.why: Quote states multi-account distribution must use OAuth, matching the claim's key part.

items.quote: As of October 26, 2026, legacy private apps can no longer be created.
items.why: Quote states legacy private apps can no longer be created from Oct 26, 2026.

items.quote: You must be a super admin to access private apps in your HubSpot account.
items.why: Super-admin requirement is consistent with admin gating, but doesn't cover approval or self-serve signup.

items.quote: The 2026-09 APIs use a date-based versioning scheme (e.g., `/crm/2026-09/`).
items.why: Quote gives date-based versioning only; no REST host, breadth, or SDK support.

items.quote: All APIs, whether legacy, new, or beta, use the same root path as before: `https://api.hubapi.com/`.
items.why: Quote gives the api.hubapi.com root path only; no breadth, versioning, or SDK support.

items.quote: PKCE is required for authenticating with HubSpot's MCP server.
items.why: Quote implies HubSpot's own MCP server exists, but is about PKCE and gives no URL.
